title: High-Performance and Resource-Efficient Dynamic Memory Management in High-Level Synthesis
problem: HLS tools lack support for dynamic memory management (DMM). Existing HLS-compatible DMM solutions cannot simultaneously achieve high performance (minimal allocation latency) and resource efficiency (managing arbitrarily sized memory with minimal FPGA resources).
motivation: Dynamic memory management support is essential for improving HLS tool usability and enabling faster FPGA-based architecture development.
method: HeroDMM organizes managed memory using a novel cartesian-like tree (CT) structure to balance allocation and deallocation latency against resource efficiency. The system implements a specialized memory management algorithm with hardware-specific optimizations to achieve high performance while supporting arbitrary memory sizes with minimal FPGA resource consumption.
key_novelty: A cartesian-like tree structure that resolves the fundamental tradeoff between memory allocation latency and FPGA resource efficiency.
contributions: Novel cartesian-like tree structure for dynamic memory organization in HLS
Specialized memory management algorithm and hardware implementation for HLS
61.69%-99.99% performance improvement over state-of-the-art DMM solutions
23.79%-97.22% resource consumption savings compared to existing approaches
primary_theme: dynamic memory management for high-level synthesis
